items: Know Your Deadline: Look up your state's security deposit statute by searching '[Your State] landlord-tenant code security deposits' to find the exact return deadline.
Document the Dates: Write down the exact date you provided your forwarding address to your landlord because this starts the clock on their legal deadline.
Count the Days: Calculate how many days have passed since you gave your forwarding address and compare it to your state's deadline to see if they already violated it.
Fill Your Reference Card: Write down your state's deadline, required delivery method, itemization requirements, and penalty structure so you know exactly how strong your case is.
Review Your Lease: Read the lease to confirm the original deposit amount, any listed deductions, and any move-in condition clauses that establish what was already damaged.
Calculate Your Claim: Subtract any legally valid deductions from your original deposit amount using your state's rules to determine exactly how much you should receive back.
Check Their Math: Compare the landlord's itemized deductions against your state's requirements to determine whether they provided adequate documentation or just made up numbers.
Identify Violations: Note every procedural error your landlord made, such as missing the deadline, failing to send by certified mail, or omitting required receipts and estimates.
Send a Demand Letter: Write and send a formal demand letter stating exactly how much you believe you're owed and citing your state's law that supports your claim.
Keep Everything: Save copies of every email, text, letter, and receipt you send or receive from your landlord as evidence in case you need to go to court.
File Small Claims Court: If your landlord doesn't respond to your demand letter, file in your local small claims court where you can represent yourself without a lawyer.
Know Your Leverage: Understand that if your landlord missed the deadline or failed to properly itemize, you may be entitled to the full deposit plus statutory damages of double or triple.
